recap.headline: Gopher Gold Runs the Town
recap.subhead: Gopher Gold owned last night; LeParth James would like it struck from the record.

zingers.line: Benched Stephon Castle for 20.0 points. 57.0 points rotting on the pine while you lost a category.
Worst box score in the league last night. Twelve teams, and you found the bottom.
Best night in the league, which says more about the other eleven than about you.
Beats most of the league on paper and still loses. Unlucky is one word for it.
Luckiest schedule in the league. The record is a lie and everybody knows it.
Up 2 spots in the power rankings this week. Somebody finally set a lineup.
Down 3 spots in the power rankings this week. Somebody stopped setting one.
